Document: ViTGAN: Generative Adversarial Networks with Vision Transformers
Section: Abstract

We introduce ViTGAN, a purely transformer-based generative adversarial network for high-fidelity image synthesis. Our model removes convolutional inductive biases and demonstrates competitive results on standard benchmarks such as CIFAR-10 and CelebA. arXiv:2107.04589

Section: 1 Introduction

Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have become a dominant paradigm for image synthesis since their introduction. Recently, vision transformers have shown strong performance on discriminative tasks, motivating their use in generative settings as well.

Document: ViTGAN: Generative Adversarial Networks with Vision Transformers
Section: 4 Experiments

We evaluate ViTGAN on CIFAR-10 and CelebA, reporting FID scores compared to convolutional baselines. Our model achieves competitive performance without any convolutional layers.

chunks.source_text: We presented ViTGAN, demonstrating that pure transformer architectures are viable for high-fidelity image generation, opening avenues for future convolution-free generative models.

Document: ViTGAN: Generative Adversarial Networks with Vision Transformers
Section: 5 Conclusion

We presented ViTGAN, demonstrating that pure transformer architectures are viable for high-fidelity image generation, opening avenues for future convolution-free generative models.
